system.description:
You manifest 2 constructs of floating water that form into Sharks of your description. They use the Water Sharks statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section.

You may command all of the Water Sharks summoned as a bonus action on your turn. The Water Shark may take an appropriate reaction if able, such as attack of opportunity. The Water Shark uses your Ninjutsu Attack bonus for its attacks and your Save DC for all of its effects save DC’s.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank the number of Sharks you summon are increased by +1.
